title: Cute Dental SVG Bundle Tooth Clipart
author: MeawwaDigitalArts
description:
📝 Description
Make dental care fun and adorable with this Cute Dental SVG Bundle 🦷✨
This sweet kawaii-style collection includes 15 charming dental and oral hygiene designs, featuring smiling teeth, toothpaste, toothbrush, floss, braces tooth, dental mirror, syringe, fresh mouthwash, tooth shield, and more.
Designed with soft pastel colors, rounded shapes, and playful expressions, these illustrations are perfect for dentist-themed crafts, kids classroom health projects, dental clinic decor, stickers, patient gifts, Cricut or Silhouette creations, and oral hygiene awareness materials.
All files are clean, high quality, and easy to cut or print — perfect for both beginners and experienced crafters.
What’s included:
🦷 15 Cute Dental Care Designs
📁 SVG, EPS, PNG formats
✂️ Compatible with Cricut, Silhouette, Brother ScanNCut
⚡ Instant digital download (no physical item)
Perfect for:
• Dentist & dental clinic crafts
• Kids oral hygiene worksheets
• Tooth fairy and health projects
• Stickers & planner decor
• Classroom health education
• Dental awareness gifts
Thank you for supporting handmade digital art! 🌟
